en_quote: Policies and procedures are essential guidelines on managing risks for an AFC compliance program.
knowledge_zh: 政策和程序是管理金融犯罪防控合规计划风险的基本指南

en_quote: In general, policies translate legal and regulatory requirements as applicable to the organization.
knowledge_zh: 政策将法律法规要求转化为适用于组织的具体规定

en_quote: Procedures are the step-bystep instructions on how to implement policies.
knowledge_zh: 程序是实施政策的逐步操作指南

en_quote: Policies and procedures generally include requirements for oversight at senior levels.
knowledge_zh: 政策和程序通常包含高级管理层的监督要求
